<!-- pr-reviewer: 89c66f6fecfae5e18cc38bb3c4ea575e436bf1b2 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

Thank you for this fix. The `.gitattributes` change is correct and it agrees with the plan in #2840. Two process items block the merge. Both have one fix: merge `upstream/main` into the branch.

### What looks good

- The PR's own commit (`89c66f6fe`) changes 4 files only: `.gitattributes`, the decision file, `testdata/models/fig8.step` and `xtask/tests/example_line_endings.rs`.
- `fig8.step` changes only its line ends. `git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol upstream/main HEAD -- testdata/models/fig8.step` is empty. The index had `i/crlf` before; it has `i/lf` now. The geometry does not change.
- After the trial merge, each tracked file that a new `eol=lf` rule selects has LF in the index (760 files, all `i/lf`). No binary file falls under a new `text` rule. `*.sc binary` stays last, so it still wins.
- The new autocrlf test makes a temporary checkout with `core.autocrlf=true` (the `git()` helper sets it). Without the new rules, the checkout writes CRLF and the test fails. This is a correct pin.
- The decision file has the chosen option, the reason and the dropped option. The body has `Changelog: none`, `Process change: yes` and `Fixes #2840`. These are correct: `xtask/tests/` is a process file.

### Results merged with main (locally)

- Trial merge with `upstream/main` (`88805e692`): **4 conflicts**:
  - `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`
  - `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`
  - `xtask/src/fixture_inputs.rs`
  - `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`
- All 4 conflicts come from commit `344635b72` (`chore(process): sync process files to upstream PROCESS_VERSION 110`). That commit copies the fork's process files at version 110. Upstream main is now at version 111. With main's side for these hunks, the merge result differs from `upstream/main` in the 4 files of `89c66f6fe` only.
- **Not built.** The shared compile cache (sccache) on the review machine stopped responding. No cargo build completed in this review. This is a fault of the review machine, not of the PR. The quick gate, clippy and the extra suites below did not run. This review does not say "pass" for them. The next head gets a full build and test run.

Extra suites run: none (not built). The next review must run:
- `xtask` tests (`example_line_endings` included), and clippy on `xtask`.
- The suites that read `testdata/models/fig8.step`: `camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`, `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`, `camcraft-app --test shoulder_adaptive`, the `camcraft-ui` lib tests `frame_cost_probe` / `frame_cost_caches`, and the heavy lane `adaptive_fig8_crossing` (release, `--ignored`).

### Requested before merge

1. **`.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` - the PR edits this file.** AGENTS.md ("Process changes bump `PROCESS_VERSION`") does not permit this edit in a PR. The merging session is the one writer. The edit comes from the fork-sync commit `344635b72` (103 -> 110). Fix: run `git merge upstream/main` on the branch (a merge commit, do not rebase). Take main's side for all 4 conflicted files. Then `git diff upstream/main --stat` must show the 4 files of `89c66f6fe` only, and no `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
2. **The PR conflicts with `main`.** The fix for item 1 also removes these conflicts. Run the quick gate again after the merge, and push (do not force-push).

### Notes (not blocking)

- `all_golden_and_fixture_files_have_eol_lf` checks fewer paths than the new rules pin. It does not check `crates/*/tests/fixtures/**`, `testdata/**/*.stl` and `testdata/**/*.obj`. You can add these 3 patterns to the test.
- `testdata/**/*.stl` and `testdata/**/*.obj` get `text eol=lf`. The 3 files there now are ASCII. A binary STL added later under this rule would be changed by Git on `git add`. A later rule such as `testdata/**/*.stl -text` for binary files, or a comment that says "ASCII STL only", prevents this.
- The body says "Non-Windows systems were not exercised locally (covered by CI)". No CI runs on a PR in this repository (AGENTS.md "GitHub Actions minutes are budgeted"). Please write what ran, and on which OS.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
This PR goes back to draft for a refresh: a merge of `main` by the maintainer's clear-out order.

The maintainer ordered a clear-out of the PRs with `conflicts` or `needs-rework`. The coordinator session of NeoTech merged `main` into this branch and repaired the review items. Nothing was force-pushed.

- New head: `cf9242d611b9ce1ab883d5283bd9af48dbeab5e7`.
- Merge of `main`: six files had a conflict. Each one came from the old fork-sync commit of this branch (`.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `xtask/src/fixture_inputs.rs`, `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`, `xtask/src/main.rs`). Each one now has the content of `main`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- Repair commit: the line-ending test also checks `crates/*/tests/fixtures/**`, `testdata/**/*.stl` and `testdata/**/*.obj`. A comment in `.gitattributes` says that the STL rule is for ASCII STL files.
- Against `main`, the content of three files changes: `.gitattributes`, `docs/decisions/2840-gitattributes-crlf-fixtures.md` and `xtask/tests/example_line_endings.rs`. `testdata/models/fig8.step` changes in its line endings only.
- Gate: a trial merge of `main` at `ee91ac3e5`, this head and other PRs passed the batch tier on Windows: 998 steps, 2 failed. The two failed steps belong to other PRs of that trial merge. The `xtask` tests passed, and the tests that read `fig8.step` passed. An agent that did not write the change ran it.
- One item of the PR body is not correct: no CI runs on a PR in this repository.

Ready for a re-check. The author is `JSwetz`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

<!-- pr-reviewer: cf9242d611b9ce1ab883d5283bd9af48dbeab5e7 -->
Review at head cf9242d61. Read, not built: the PR is from a fork, so its code does not run on the maintainer's runners, and no local build slot was free.

The two findings of the earlier review:
1. The `PROCESS_VERSION` edit: met. The merge `616ec7a4b` takes main's side for that file, and `git diff main...head` no longer lists `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The diff now touches four files: `.gitattributes`, `docs/decisions/2840-gitattributes-crlf-fixtures.md`, `testdata/models/fig8.step`, `xtask/tests/example_line_endings.rs`.
2. The conflict with main: met at GitHub now (MERGEABLE). Its resolution is right: the other conflict, in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, shows no extra lines in the remerge-diff, so both sides are kept.

The change reads well:
- `.gitattributes` widens the golden rule to all crates, adds `recorded/` and `fixtures/`, `**/*.mch`, and `testdata/**/*.step|stp|stl|obj` with `text eol=lf`. The comment about ASCII STL is correct and important: I checked every `.stl` and `.obj` file in the tree - all 19 are text files to git, so no binary fixture can be damaged by the rule today. A binary STL added later needs its own `-text` line. The new test `cf9242d61` checks the fixture, STEP, STL and OBJ rules, so the rules are pinned.
- `testdata/models/fig8.step` is the same STEP text with its stored ends changed to LF - the pin the rule asks for.
- The body carries `Process change: yes` and does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`: the process rule is obeyed.

Not built, and the change reaches every checkout on Windows, so it waits for the maintainer's look. Labels are not changed by this review.

Merge: the coordinator merges head cf9242d61 with the maintainer's word. Review: SlaveSession's clean review on this head (comment 7051290838). Gate: the stack-5 batch tier on the merged tree (local, Windows), the xtask tests (229 passed) and the light tier are green. The labels needs-rework and conflicts are stale for this head; the coordinator removes them. A PROCESS_VERSION bump follows.
